lastCommit.message:
OTA-1862 — the beat keeps its way out (SE popup/modal small-viewport repair)

The owner reported, on a physical iPhone SE, that not every popup is
resolution-aware and some run off the screen, and ruled it a confirmed UI
defect rather than a speculative audit. Constraint: SAME UI / SAME CONTENT /
SAME INTERACTION / RESPONSIVE BOUNDS.

ONE PROVEN DEFECT CLASS. The kit carries two modal shells (OTA-1777).
`modalCard` — the DIALOG — has capped its height at 85% since OTA-1614.
`momentCard` — the BEAT — declared no ceiling at all. The asymmetry stayed
invisible because Family B's six adopters solve containment two ways:
DogOnboarding, GolemNaming and WandererEncounter put the whole card INSIDE a
ScrollView that is a flex child of the scrim; CombatPrimer, MissionComplete and
MissionStinger hang the card straight off `momentScrim`, whose centring pushes
overflow off BOTH ends at once. Three of six were bounded by accident of
construction and three were not bounded at all.

MEASURED FROM THE AUTHORED CORPUS. A mission stinger is the worst real shape:
`line` is `stageDef.stinger ?? stageDef.narration` and `granted` is the pack
receipt for a RANGE of stages. Across 50 arcs / 281 stages the ceilings are a
403-character line ("The Mud Titan of the Endless Stair") and 8 grant-bearing
stages in one arc ("The Red Tower's Mouth"). On the narrowest supported phone
that card wants 780pt in a 667pt window — 113pt of overflow, centred, so ~56pt
left the screen at each end and the CTA went with the bottom. The arithmetic
also produced a finding: 0.85 x (932 - 48) = 751pt, so that beat overflows
EVERY supported device; the SE only meets it soonest.

THE REPAIR IS GEOMETRY, AND ONLY GEOMETRY.
- app/ui/tartariaKit.tsx: `momentCard` gains `maxHeight: '85%'` — the same
  value, spelled the same way, that Family A already had. Inert for the three
  that wrap: a percentage resolves against a parent with a DEFINITE size, and a
  ScrollView's content container has none along its scroll axis.
- MissionStingerModal: its card is PRIVATE by OTA-1777's governed exception
  ("remains EXPERIENTIAL"), so the kit's ceiling does not reach it. Taking
  `tMomentCard` would buy safety by reversing an owner ruling; the one value is
  copied instead and the exception survives intact. Its prose, receipts and
  next-line move into a ScrollView, title and rule pinned above, CTA pinned
  below — OTA-1614's shape.
- CombatPrimerModal / MissionCompleteModal: bodies gain `flexShrink: 1,
  flexGrow: 0`, the pair BrandedModal's `scrollArea` has carried since
  OTA-1799. Without it RN's `flexShrink: 0` default would push the pinned
  control through the card's new bottom edge instead of yielding. Their own
  360/380 reading windows are untouched — those are the card's, not the
  screen's.

No content is deleted, shortened, hidden or conditionally omitted; a beat that
already fitted is laid out by exactly the tree it always was.

COVERAGE. New suite ota1862TheBeatKeepsItsWayOut, 23 tests: level-1 arithmetic
over DEVICE_PROFILES reading the scrim gutter and the ceiling from the shipped
styles; a tree-wide RULE (a card that is a direct child of `momentScrim` must
declare a ceiling) rather than three filenames, so the seventh moment modal
fails here instead of on a phone; level-2 renders the real components and asks
structurally whether the data-sized region has a scrolling ancestor and the way
out does not. Representative shapes A-E all covered.

ota1777's exhaustive shell assertion is amended, not weakened: the original
seven values are still asserted exactly, with the new ceiling held separately.

Four negative controls, applied and restored byte-exact, none committed:
NC1 remove both ceilings -> 10 red; NC2 unscroll the stinger body -> reachability
red; NC5 break the shared primitive while leaving the governed local exception
intact -> 8 red, and the two exception tests correctly stay green; NC6 replace
the percentage with the fixed SE number -> 7 red including large-screen
preservation. NC2 and NC5 each exposed a real gap in the suite (a vacuous
0 === 0 equality, and an offender scan that trusted the primitive instead of
reading it); both were widened before proceeding.

Validation on this tree: 22/22 check gates, typecheck:ci, typecheck:tests
(192 < 201 baseline), lint, and one test:ci:fast — 1357/1357 suites,
15548 passed / 3 skipped.

SE regression covered in automation; physical-device confirmation pending
owner observation.
